Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Mult: The fastest a beginner can ever learn Strength and Fitness. A character in top form with food, sleep and supplements approaches this; anyone else learns slower.
The fastest learning at levels 2 and 3. Raising it shortens the early grind; lowering it makes every level feel like the last one.
The fastest learning at levels 4 and 5.
The fastest learning at levels 6 and 7.
The fastest learning at levels 8 and 9. Level 10 has no multiplier at all: there is nothing left to learn.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Shar: How much of the multiplier is earned by being in shape. The five weights are shared out automatically, so raising one lowers the others: what matters is their size next to each other.
How much of the multiplier a stocked protein supply is worth. Protein has to be found on the map, so this is what a supplement run buys you.
How much of the multiplier a stocked creatine supply is worth.
How much of the multiplier a rested character is worth. Unlike protein and creatine, this one needs nothing but a night's sleep to keep full.
How much of the multiplier being fed and watered is worth. Half of it is food, half is water.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Exer: Once you train past the day's free minutes, the extra XP you earn from exercise shrinks. The XP the game gives on its own is never touched. Turn it off to keep the full bonus - a heavy day still costs you tone and form either way.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Adap: How fast training builds physical form. Only training builds it - food, supplements and drugs never do it on their own.
Most one stretch of training can be worth
How much finished training can be waiting to turn into form at any one time. Anything trained past this is not kept, so two good workouts a day are worth more than six.
Hours for a workout to become form
How long your body needs to turn a finished workout into lasting form. The clock only runs while your character is in the world.
Form slips when you stop training

Turn this off and the form you have built holds exactly where it is, however long you go without training. The two lines below then do nothing. Training still raises it, and form already lost does not come back.
Hours off before form starts to slip
How long you can go without training before the form you built starts to fade. Only time with your character in the world counts. At 0 it starts fading the moment a workout ends.
Days off that undo your form
How many days without training take your form all the way back down. The count starts when the hours in the line above have run out. Only time with your character in the world counts.

The shortest workout that builds any form at all, counted in training minutes: one set taken to the point where your character stops on their own is 25 of them, whatever the clock says. Short bursts inside the same half hour add up.
Workout length that pays in full

The workout length that earns the full benefit, counted in training minutes. One set taken to exhaustion is 25. A shorter workout that still counts earns proportionally less, down to half; training longer than this earns nothing extra.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Trai: How much training a day your body shrugs off, counted in training minutes: one set taken to exhaustion is 25, so two of them already go past 45. Train more than this and the day's load builds up: the extra XP from training shrinks and keeps shrinking until you rest, so a rest day becomes part of the routine.
Hours to shake off a day of training
How long the body needs to clear that training load. Only time with your character in the world counts.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Slee: Auto counts a sleepless character as tired, except on a server where sleep is switched off. Ignore never holds a sleepless character back. Either way you are never required to sleep.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Read: How much tiredness holds you back
How much a sleepless character loses when turning training into physical form. 0 means training while exhausted costs nothing.
How much hunger and thirst hold you back
How much a hungry or thirsty character loses when turning training into physical form. Whichever is worse is the one that counts. 0 means training on an empty stomach costs nothing.
Worst case is still this good
The lowest a wrecked character can ever fall. At 50 even a starving, sleepless character still makes half the progress of a rested one; at 0 a wrecked character makes none.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Tone: How long a training tone lasts
The longest a training tone can last, in game hours. Only time with your character in the world counts.
Extra kilograms you can carry while a light Strength tone lasts. It is added on top of what your Strength level already allows. 0 turns this stage off.
Extra kilograms you can carry while a solid Strength tone lasts.
Extra kilograms you can carry while a peak Strength tone lasts. A drug course can push it higher still.
How strongly a light cardio tone works: it hands back part of the wind you just spent and refills the rest faster. 0 turns this stage off.
How strongly a solid cardio tone hands back spent wind and refills the rest.
How strongly a peak cardio tone hands back spent wind and refills the rest. At 15 a full bar refills in about five and a half hours of tone.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Endu: Cardio tone gives back spent wind
A cardio tone hands back a small part of the wind you just spent. Turn it off to keep only the faster refill.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Nutr: How long a scoop keeps working
How long one scoop of protein or creatine keeps working. It does not feed you: hunger and tiredness are unaffected. Only time with your character in the world counts.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Supp: How long one drug dose lasts
How long a single anabolic or cardio dose lasts before it wears off. Five doses reach full strength, so keeping a course going costs one more dose every time this time runs out.
How long a course takes to work
How long a course needs before it works at full strength. A dose counts the moment you take it but is felt gradually, so one pill is far weaker than a course you keep up.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Cour: Anabolic course: how much faster you learn

A course you keep going speeds Strength up by this many percent, and makes a Strength tone that much stronger. Coming off costs exactly as much as it gave: the gain goes, and while the crash lasts you learn that much slower. At 100 the course teaches twice as fast and the crash takes the whole bonus away. At 0 the drug does nothing good and every side effect stays.
Cardio course: how much faster you learn

A course you keep going speeds Fitness up by this many percent, and makes a cardio tone that much stronger. Coming off costs exactly as much as it gave: the gain goes, and while the crash lasts you learn that much slower. At 100 the course teaches twice as fast and the crash takes the whole bonus away. At 0 the drug does nothing good and every side effect stays.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Supp: Scales the unpleasant side of a course and of the crash after it: stress, gloom, thirst, stamina and stiff muscles. At 100 they hit at full strength, at 200 twice as hard, and 0 removes them. The learning ceiling is not part of this - that is the line below.

A course you keep going lifts your learning ceiling, and the crash then takes that lift back and needs about ten days to fade. Turn it off and the ceiling only ever rises: when the course runs out it settles back to normal and never drops below it. What a course costs you while you are on it is the line above.
How long a pre-workout dose lasts
Game hours of play during which a pre-workout dose keeps exercise from leaving you stiff, and clears stiffness you already have faster. 0 turns both effects off.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Stim: How many pre-workout doses can be held at once. Drinking more than this is wasted. At 2 the effect holds for two full days.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Supp: How long a thermogenic dose lasts

Game hours of play one thermogenic dose buys. While it works the character burns into a calorie deficit and runs hot, so weight comes off even while eating normally. Doses stack up to a full bottle. 0 turns the item off.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Ther: How many thermogenic doses can be held at once. At 5 a whole bottle stacks, which is exactly what one bottle is worth.
Sandbox_PhysicalProgressionOverhaul_Loot: How often the anabolic and cardio preparations turn up. Look in pharmacies, hospital storage, medicine cabinets, drug labs and drug shacks, never in gyms or shops. Each step multiplies how common they are: Normal is the usual rate, Abundant is three times that, and the lowest step keeps them out of the world entirely.

How often protein powder and creatine complex turn up. Look in home fitness stashes, gym lockers and weight racks, sport shops and grocery back rooms. Each step multiplies how common they are: Normal is the usual rate, Abundant is three times that, and the lowest step keeps them out of the world entirely.

How often the calorie gainer, electrolyte complex, pre-workout and thermogenic turn up. Look in sport shops, gym lockers, convenience and gas station shelves, pharmacies and grocery back rooms. Each step multiplies how common they are: Normal is the usual rate, Abundant is three times that, and the lowest step keeps them out of the world entirely.
